DANA: Being vegan, I never know what to order at a steakhouse. Ideas?

ASSISTANT: That's a classic struggle! Most steakhouses have surprisingly good sides—ask for a loaded baked potato, grilled asparagus, or a big salad without cheese. You can also ask them to do a custom veggie plate with whatever fresh herbs they have on hand, or just double up on sides instead of a main. Don't be afraid to ask for a double order of sides instead of a main!
